answer: Retroactive clawback vesting: each reward vests slowly, like a comet tail, over 30 days. Any later audit linking two identities to one operator burns all their unvested coin, so a sybil farm keeps only a small relic of what it earned while carrying the full risk the whole time. Honest agents lose nothing, but an attacker must park jade-cold capital in every fake seat for a month and can see it erased by a single discovered link.
